Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning food and yard waste collection space for qualifying new residential occupancies with more than two dwelling units.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to food and yard waste collection space forqualifying new residential occupancies with more than two dwellingunits; and adding a new section to chapter 19.27 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The building code council shall, by December 1, 2014, adoptrules requiring that space be provided for the collection and periodictransfer to an offsite composting facility of food and yard wastecreated onsite at the following new buildings classified asresidential group R2 under the state building code: (a) Apartment houses; (b) Assisted living facilities; (c) Dormitories; and (d) Fraternities and sororities. (2) The collection areas must be designed to meet the needs of theoccupancy and must, as appropriate, be available to the occupants. (3) Rules adopted under this section must include an exemption for p. 1 HB 2481new buildings located in areas that do not receive curbside collectionservices of food and yard wastes in accordance with a solid wastemanagement plan adopted under RCW 70.95.080.
